setting: Grand Paris hotel lobby, marble floor, brass bell on the desk, late 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Câu lịch sự nói với lễ tân khách sạn khi đến nhận phòng.
phrase.example_en: I'd like to check in, please.
phrase.example_vi: Tôi muốn nhận phòng ạ.

hook_vi: Anh đặt phòng kiểu gì đây? 😳

Jamie leans on the desk with his best grin.
The clerk slides over a single key on a heart-shaped keychain; Viv stares at it, brow raised.
Jamie innocent, hands up.

line.vi: Giảm giá lãng mạn. Rất Pháp đó.

Viv sprawls across a huge bed; Jamie folded like a pretzel on a tiny sofa, knees at his ears.

setting: Cozy jazz club in Greenwich Village, red velvet booths, candles, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Cách lịch sự hỏi xem mình có thể ngồi cùng ai đó không.
phrase.example_en: Mind if I join you?
phrase.example_vi: Tôi ngồi cùng bạn được không?

hook_vi: Chỗ cuối cùng và một chàng trai 😍

shots.action: Packed jazz club; Sienna in a green velvet dress circles with a drink, only one empty stool at the bar next to Theo in a tuxedo.
Sienna taps the stool, big hopeful smile.

line.vi: Em ngồi cùng anh được không?

shots.action: Theo deadpan, pats a small potted plant on the stool.
Sienna blinks at the plant, then laughs.
Theo hides a smile, moves the plant to his lap.
Sienna sits; Theo holds the plant like a baby and tips its leaf at her.

twist: The plant is the matchmaker.

setting: Yellow New York taxi stuck in morning traffic, wipers on, courthouse steps visible ahead, late 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Bảo tài xế chạy nhanh hết cỡ vì đang gấp.
phrase.example_en: We're late. Floor it!
phrase.example_vi: Trễ rồi. Đạp hết ga đi!

hook_vi: Trễ phiên tòa, tài xế lại là anh

Maya, half-out of breath, sees who is driving.
Lucas adjusts the mirror, deadpan.
Maya checks her watch, tapping the seat.
Lucas lifts one finger and points ahead; a line of ducklings crosses the road in front of the cab.
Maya stares at the ducklings, then at Lucas, then laughs and rests her chin on the seat back.

twist: The rushed lawyer gets stuck behind ducks with the calm neighbour as driver.

phrase.explain_vi: Cách lịch sự nhờ phục vụ mang hóa đơn ở nhà hàng.
phrase.example_en: The bill, please.
phrase.example_vi: Làm ơn tính tiền giúp tôi.

hook_vi: Anh ấy lén làm điều này 😳

Viv waves elegantly toward an off-screen waiter.
Theo lowers his eyes, pats his pockets once, twice, slowly.
Viv narrows her eyes, suspicious.
Theo points over his shoulder where the accordion player waves back at him.

line.vi: Anh trả tiền cho cây đàn.

shots.action: A waiter lays a long receipt on the table; Viv holds it up, jaw dropped, Theo sips water innocently.

twist: He tipped the musician and forgot the actual bill.
cta_vi: Bạn từng quên trả tiền chưa? 😅 Comment nhé

setting: Busy Tokyo train station concourse with signs everywhere, commuters passing, 1990s

phrase.vi: bạn có thể chỉ giúp tôi đến

phrase.example_en: Could you point me to the exit?
phrase.example_vi: Bạn chỉ giúp tôi lối ra được không?

hook_vi: Lạc ở Tokyo mà vẫn tán được 😂

shots.action: Sienna spins in the middle of a crowded Tokyo station holding a map upside down; Jamie holds a pastry box nearby.
Sienna taps Jamie's shoulder, bright and polite.

line.en: Could you point me to the exit?
line.vi: Anh chỉ em lối ra được không?

shots.action: Jamie turns, grinning, points a finger at his own chest.
Sienna gasps then laughs, relieved to have company.
Jamie offers her half of a croissant from the box.

line.vi: Người lạc cần đồ ăn vặt.

shots.action: They stand by a station sign in a crowd; they both point in opposite directions, then see the exit sign right behind them.

twist: Two lost tourists wander off together and the exit was behind them the whole time.
cta_vi: Bạn từng lạc ở đâu? Comment bằng tiếng Anh nhé 👇

phrase.explain_vi: Ghế ngồi sát cửa sổ máy bay.
phrase.example_en: Can I have a window seat?
phrase.example_vi: Cho tôi ghế cạnh cửa sổ được không?

hook_vi: Giành ghế máy bay như đánh trận

shots.action: Maya in a blazer and Theo in a camel coat stand side by side at an airline counter, both gripping boarding forms.
Maya leans in with a lawyer's smile.
Theo glances at her, polite but firm.
Maya raises a brow, a challenge.
Theo slides a coin onto the counter like a duel.
Both sit in an airplane row, Maya happily at the window, Theo squeezed in the middle seat with a snoring passenger resting on his shoulder.

twist: She wins the coin toss and he loses the aisle too.

setting: Sunny Los Angeles apartment hallway at noon, door open, suitcase on the floor, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Cảm giác mệt mỏi, buồn ngủ sai giờ sau chuyến bay dài qua nhiều múi giờ.

hook_vi: Ngủ gục giữa bữa trưa 😴

Lucas deadpan, offering the mug.

line.vi: Chào mừng về. Cà phê không?

shots.action: Sienna yawns so wide her eyes water.

line.en: I can't. I have jet lag.
line.vi: Không được. Em bị lệch múi giờ.

shots.action: Lucas lifts a brow, checks his watch.
Sienna's eyes droop; she slowly leans her head onto Lucas's shoulder.
Sienna sleeps standing up against Lucas, mouth open; Lucas stands frozen, still holding the mug, not daring to move.

twist: Jet lag turns the neighbor into a pillow.

phrase.example_vi: Bạn dẫn tôi đi tham quan thành phố được không?

shots.action: Viv and Jamie at the top of the Montmartre steps; Viv holds a guidebook, Jamie a baguette.
Viv hands the guidebook to Jamie with a smirk.

line.en: You said you'd show me around.
line.vi: Anh bảo sẽ dẫn em đi mà.

shots.action: Jamie squints at a map, utterly confident.
Viv deadpan.

line.en: That's a bakery. We know bakeries.
line.vi: Đó là tiệm bánh. Mình biết rồi.

shots.action: Jamie points at a small stone building with grand pride.

line.vi: Còn kia là... tiệm bánh khác.

shots.action: Viv laughs, takes his arm, both walk down the steps eating the baguette together.

twist: The tour guide is just a baker showing her every bakery in Paris.

phrase.explain_vi: Nơi đông khách du lịch, đắt đỏ và không đáng đi.

phrase.example_vi: Chỗ đó là bẫy du lịch đấy.

hook_vi: Cô luật sư bị chặt chém 😂

shots.action: Maya in a blazer and Jamie in a pea coat stand in a neon street; a street seller waves a huge foam hat at them.
Maya reads the price tag on the hat, outraged.

line.vi: Ba mươi đô cho miếng xốp?

shots.action: Jamie, wearing the foam hat already, shrugs.
Maya looks at him, hands on hips.
Jamie happily holds up two foam hats.

line.vi: Hai cái năm mươi. Hời đấy.

shots.action: Maya in a foam crown and Jamie in a foam hat stand with a giant foam finger, a photographer snaps them.

line.en: I hate how good this looks.
line.vi: Em ghét là nhìn đẹp thế.

cta_vi: Bạn từng mắc bẫy du lịch nào? Comment 👇

setting: Snowy mountain trail near a Colorado lodge, deep powder, pine trees, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Nơi vắng vẻ, ít du khách biết, không phải chỗ phổ biến.
phrase.example_en: We found a place off the beaten path.
phrase.example_vi: Mình tìm được chỗ ít người biết đến.

hook_vi: Anh ấy dẫn em đi đâu thế này?

Sienna panting, steam from her mouth.

line.vi: Chỗ này không có trên bản đồ.

shots.action: Theo grins, unbothered.
Sienna lifts a ski pole that sinks in snow up to her glove.
Theo pushes aside a pine branch to reveal a hidden warm cabin with a picnic set and lanterns.
Sienna beams at the cabin then turns to Theo with narrowed eyes.

line.vi: Anh lên kế hoạch hết rồi.

cta_vi: Chỗ hẹn hò bí mật của bạn ở đâu? Comment 👇

setting: Empty airport gate at 3 a.m., rows of plastic seats, big window with runway lights, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Thời gian chờ giữa hai chuyến bay khi nối chuyến.

phrase.example_vi: Tôi có năm tiếng quá cảnh.

hook_vi: Quá cảnh năm tiếng cùng hàng xóm 😅

shots.action: Maya in a gray sweatshirt sprawls across three airport seats; Lucas in a black tee walks up with two paper cups.
Lucas, deadpan, holds out a cup.

line.vi: Quá cảnh năm tiếng. Trà không?

shots.action: Maya squints at him, still half asleep.

line.vi: Trong ngần ấy sân bay, lại là anh?

shots.action: Lucas sits two seats away and opens a tiny chess set.
Maya sits up, sparkling with competition.
They bend over a chess game; behind them the window shows a plane leaving the gate with their passengers boarding.

phrase.explain_vi: Tấm thẻ hoặc giấy cho phép bạn lên máy bay.

phrase.example_vi: Tôi làm mất thẻ lên máy bay rồi.

Viv, calmly panicking, flips through her passport.

line.vi: Thẻ lên máy bay đâu rồi?

Viv touches her ear, finds it, and straightens with a regal air.
Sienna giggles, holding her own pass up; it's upside down in the wrong hand.

line.vi: Em nhìn đã sẵn sàng chưa?

line.vi: Cảm ơn. Đừng nói ai nhé.

phrase.example_vi: Có kèm bữa sáng không ạ?

Maya spots Theo's plate stacked high with croissants.
Theo, calmly buttering a roll.
Maya eyes the plate, a lawyer finding evidence.
Theo offers her one with a charming dimple smile.

hook_vi: Chuyện nhỏ nhưng ngại muốn chết

line.vi: Tôi trả bằng thẻ được không?

hook_vi: Chuyến bay bay mất, người ở lại 💔

Sienna presses her hands on the glass, devastated.
Theo, sitting on a gate chair with a book, looks up calmly.
Sienna turns to him, surprised.

phrase.example_vi: Chúc bạn may mắn lần sau.

hook_vi: Hai tấm vé cuối cùng... của ai?

Lucas places two fingers on the same tickets, calm.
Maya leans closer to the glass, glaring.
The ticket seller drops a hand-lettered sign over the window; Lucas reads it, deadpan.

Viv in the coop with a hen on her lap, Jamie holding a lantern; the hen lays an egg right on Viv's pink sleeve.

Lucas deadpan, stares at the ceiling.

line.vi: Chào buổi sáng. Cuộc gọi đây.

line.en: The hotel gave me the job.

line.vi: Anh nhờ người quen được không?

shots.action: Lucas deadpan, looks at a small brass door marked STAGE.
Lucas goes backstage; the marionettes onstage suddenly all bow toward the audience and then toward Viv; Viv covers her laugh.
Lucas reappears holding two tickets and a thick string tied around his finger.
A puppeteer above them waves two string-controlled hands; Viv waves back at him and takes Lucas's arm into the theatre.

twist: He literally pulls strings and the puppets bow.
cta_vi: Bạn có quen ai để nhờ vả không? Comment 👇

setting: Dark airplane cabin at 3 a.m. with soft blue lights and sleeping passengers, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Chuyến bay đêm làm bạn mệt đến đỏ mắt.
phrase.example_en: I took the red-eye to New York.
phrase.example_vi: Tôi đi chuyến bay đêm đến New York.

hook_vi: Chuyến bay đêm, mắt đỏ hoe 😅

shots.action: Dark airplane cabin; Theo in a camel coat and Sienna in a denim jacket sit side by side with eye masks on their foreheads, yawning.
Sienna lifts her eye mask, squinting at the cabin lights.

line.vi: Sao gọi là chuyến bay đêm?

shots.action: Theo, deadpan, turns to her with heavy lids.
Sienna stares; his eyes are bloodshot red; she gasps and giggles.

line.en: Oh. You look like a rabbit.
line.vi: Ồ. Anh nhìn như con thỏ.

shots.action: Theo studies her cheek, dry.
They fall asleep leaning on each other; a flight attendant tucks a blanket over them and puts two tiny fans on the tray table.

twist: Both have rabbit eyes by the end of the red-eye.
cta_vi: Bạn có từng đi chuyến bay đêm? Comment 👇

setting: Old Paris bookshop with tall shelves, a spiral staircase and a glass case, evening lamplight, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Quá bất ngờ hoặc xúc động nên không biết nói gì.
phrase.example_en: I'm lost for words.
phrase.example_vi: Tôi không nói nên lời.

hook_vi: Lần đầu cô ấy hết lời để nói

shots.action: Maya in a red satin dress follows Lucas in a black suit through an old Paris bookshop after closing hour; Lucas stops before a locked glass case.
Lucas turns the key and lifts out a worn book with gold lettering.
Maya reads the first page; her mouth falls open; her eyes grow wet.
Lucas nods once, small smile.

line.vi: Sách em thích. Có chữ ký.

shots.action: Maya opens her mouth, closes it, opens it again, hand on chest.
Lucas, deadpan, leans on the case, a tiny smile on his lips.

twist: The talkative lawyer is speechless for the first time and he enjoys it.
cta_vi: Món quà nào làm bạn xúc động? Comment 👇

setting: Hotel garden with a pool and a faraway hazy beach beyond rolling dunes, sunny afternoon, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Rất gần, chỉ cách một quãng ngắn.
phrase.example_en: It's a stone's throw from the beach.
phrase.example_vi: Nó cách bãi biển một tầm ném đá.

hook_vi: Cách biển chỉ một tầm ném đá?

shots.action: Jamie in a pea coat holds a hotel brochure by a garden pool; Sienna in a denim jacket looks toward a distant hazy beach beyond tall dunes.
Jamie reads the brochure, proud.

line.en: It says a stone's throw from the beach.
line.vi: Ghi là cách biển một tầm ném đá.

shots.action: Sienna squints at the faraway shore and picks up a small stone.
Sienna winds up and throws; the stone plops into the pool two feet away; she shrugs; a duck quacks in disapproval.
Jamie closes the brochure, eyes mournful.

line.en: They have a very weak arm.
line.vi: Người viết có cánh tay yếu.

shots.action: They walk across the dunes together with towels on their shoulders; Sienna keeps throwing stones ahead, Jamie ducking each one.

twist: The beach is a mile away; they walk there throwing stones.
cta_vi: Chỗ nào bạn thấy quảng cáo nói sai? Comment 👇

setting: Empty seaside resort with closed umbrellas, grey sky then pale sun, a lone man in many hats, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Thời gian ít khách du lịch, thường rẻ hơn.
phrase.example_en: It's cheaper in the off-season.
phrase.example_vi: Mùa thấp điểm rẻ hơn.

hook_vi: Resort chỉ có một nhân viên

shots.action: Viv in a camel wrap coat and Jamie in a pea coat walk down an empty windy beach lined with folded umbrellas.
Jamie spreads his arms to the empty sand.
Viv holds her hair against the wind, brow arched.
A man in a waiter's apron runs up to them with a tray; he turns and reappears in a lifeguard hat with a whistle; then in a chef's hat.
Jamie watches the same man change hats, impressed.

line.vi: Ông ấy là cả khu nghỉ dưỡng.

shots.action: The man in a bellhop hat serves Viv a coffee and bows; Viv sips it with a straight face as he sprints off to be the band.

line.vi: Dịch vụ tốt nhất thị trấn.

twist: One man plays every role at the empty resort.
cta_vi: Bạn thích đi du lịch mùa nào? Comment 👇

setting: Summit of a mountain trail crammed with hikers in colorful jackets lining up for a selfie at the top, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Thời gian có nhiều khách du lịch nhất trong năm.
phrase.example_en: Don't travel in peak season.
phrase.example_vi: Đừng đi du lịch vào mùa cao điểm.

hook_vi: Lên đỉnh núi mà phải xếp hàng

shots.action: Lucas in a black tee and Maya in a grey sweatshirt, sweaty, reach a summit crowded with hikers lined up with cameras.
Maya, panting, stares at the queue at the summit rock.

line.en: There's a line at the top?
line.vi: Có hàng ở trên đỉnh à?

shots.action: Lucas deadpan, looking at the line.
Maya laughs breathless, resting hands on her knees.

line.en: Peak season. On a peak. Literally.
line.vi: Mùa cao điểm. Trên đỉnh. Đúng nghĩa.

shots.action: Lucas holds up a small camera with a flat smile.
A hiker takes their photo as Maya sneaks in front of a boulder; the boulder's real peak is behind a huge group; they smile anyway.

line.en: The real summit is the picnic.
line.vi: Đỉnh thật sự là bữa picnic.

twist: They queue for a summit selfie and picnic instead.
cta_vi: Bạn đã leo núi nào? Comment 👇

setting: Elegant hotel suite on a stormy day with rain streaking the windows, bedsheets draped over chairs, 1990s

phrase.explain_vi: Tận hưởng hoặc khai thác hết khả năng của một hoàn cảnh.
phrase.example_en: It rained, but we made the most of it.
phrase.example_vi: Trời mưa nhưng bọn tôi tận dụng tối đa.

hook_vi: Mưa cả ngày, vẫn đi chơi!

shots.action: Hotel suite in a storm; Viv in pink satin pajamas flops on a sofa, sighing; Theo in a navy sweater looks out at the lashing rain.
Viv groans at the window.
Theo turns, a dimple on his cheek, picking up a bedsheet.

line.en: Let's make the most of it.
line.vi: Mình tận dụng tối đa đi.

shots.action: Theo drapes sheets over two chairs, creating a tent; Viv holds up a flashlight; the room becomes a cozy fort.
Viv crawls inside with room-service tea, eyes sparkling.
Inside the tent, Theo reads a book by flashlight; Viv listens; the storm thunders and they both smile, shoulder to shoulder.

twist: The rainy day becomes a blanket-fort date.
cta_vi: Bạn làm gì khi trời mưa cả ngày? Comment 👇
